results.question: How many sellers are based in Sao Paulo city?

sql.text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers WHERE seller_city = 'sao paulo'

results.question: How many sellers are in the state of Sao Paulo?

sql.text: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'SP'

results.question: How many orders are in the data?

sql.text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

results.question: How many orders were delivered?

sql.text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

results.question: How many orders placed in 2017 were canceled?

sql.text:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'canceled'
  AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017'

results.question: How many distinct customers have ordered from us?

sql.text: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM customers

results.question: How many customers placed more than one order in 2017?

sql.text:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017'
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)

results.question: What percentage of customers have ordered more than once?

sql.text:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)

results.question: What is our total revenue?

sql.text: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price + freight_value), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items

results.question: What was GMV in 2018?

sql.text:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv_2018
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'

results.question: What percentage of delivered orders arrived late?

sql.text:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

results.question: How many orders placed in 2018 were delivered late?

sql.text:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders
FROM orders
WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

results.question: What share of delivered orders in cama_mesa_banho arrived late, by month of purchase in 2018?

sql.text:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name = 'cama_mesa_banho'
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

results.question: Which sellers in Sao Paulo city had 5 or more late deliveries in 2018 Q2?

sql.text:
SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(*) AS late_deliveries
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE s.seller_city = 'sao paulo'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp BETWEEN '2018-04-01' AND '2018-06-30'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date
GROUP BY s.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY late_deliveries DESC

results.question: What were the top 10 product categories by GMV in 2018, with English names?

sql.text:
SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 10

results.question: Which product categories have no English translation?

sql.text:
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_category_name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE t.product_category_name IS NULL

results.question: How many products have no category?

sql.text: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL

results.question: What is the average review score?

sql.text: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM order_reviews

results.question: What percentage of reviews created in 2018 gave one star?

sql.text:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS one_star_pct
FROM order_reviews
WHERE strftime('%Y', review_creation_date) = '2018'

results.question: How many reviews have a written comment?

sql.text: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL

results.question: Which 5 customer states placed the most orders?

sql.text:
SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: On average, how many days does a delivered order take from purchase to the customer?

sql.text:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

results.question: How many delivered orders have no delivery date?

sql.text: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL

results.question: How many sellers sold at least one item in 2018?

sql.text:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS active_sellers
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'

results.question: How many orders contain items from more than one seller?

sql.text:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_multiple_sellers
FROM (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1
)

results.question: What share of payment value came from each payment type?

sql.text:
SELECT payment_type,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(payment_value) / (SELECT SUM(payment_value) FROM order_payments), 2) AS pct_of_value
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY pct_of_value DESC

results.question: What was the average order value in 2017, based on payments?

sql.text:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(op.payment_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017'

results.question: What was the total payment value of 2018 orders that included a beleza_saude product?

sql.text:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(op.payment_value), 2) AS total_paid
FROM order_payments op
JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name = 'beleza_saude'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'

results.question: Which 5 sellers had the highest GMV in 2018?

sql.text:
SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
GROUP BY oi.seller_id
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: How many distinct customers in Sao Paulo city have ordered from us?

sql.text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE customer_city = 'sao paulo'
